title: Sidewinder Mk I (Elite Dangerous)
intro: The Sidewinder Mk I by Faulcon DeLacy is the small free starter ship every new pilot gets. It has a tiny single-seat cockpit and fits the small landing pads. It uses the same cockpit system and HOTAS layout as every Elite Dangerous ship.

panels.name: Sidewinder Mk I: seats and hardpoints
panels.text: Facts about the Sidewinder Mk I that set it apart from the other ships: its seats, its weapon mounts and the landing pad size it needs.
panels.context: Everything else in the Sidewinder Mk I's cockpit works like in every other Elite Dangerous ship.

controls.name: Pilot seat (helm)
controls.text: The only seat of the Sidewinder Mk I. The pilot sits here and flies the ship with the whole HOTAS layout of this guide.
controls.context: With one seat the Sidewinder Mk I cannot take multicrew guests; the pilot does everything alone.

controls.name: Hardpoints (weapon mounts)
controls.text: The weapon mounts of the Sidewinder Mk I: two small hardpoints. Bigger mounts take bigger, stronger weapons.
controls.context: The pilot puts the Sidewinder Mk I's weapons into fire groups on the right panel and fires them with the trigger and the weapon release button.

controls.name: Landing pad size
controls.text: The Sidewinder Mk I needs a small landing pad or a bigger one. Stations have small, medium and large pads, and small outposts may not have the bigger ones.
controls.context: When the pilot asks a station for docking, the station gives a pad that fits the ship's size.
